Definition: from G2596 and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out):--pour.
BiblicalUsage: A woman poured the ointment down over Jesus, breaking the box and anointing His head while He sat at meat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe her pouring was worship, and the waste the others saw was the point.
